messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Albuterol is a bronchodilator.
Albuterol relaxes muscles in the airways.
Albuterol increases air flow to the lungs.
Albuterol inhalation is used to treat or prevent bronchospasm.
Bronchospasm is the narrowing of the airways in the lungs.
Albuterol inhalation is used in people with asthma.
Albuterol inhalation is used in people with certain types of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD).
Albuterol is also used to prevent exercise-induced bronchospasm.
Albuterol inhalation is for use in adults and children who are at least 2 years old.
Always follow your doctor's directions when giving albuterol to a child.
Triplet: ["Albuterol Inhalation", "has age restriction", "for use in adults and children who are at least 2 years old"]

The relation 'has age restriction' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is restricted for use in the age group specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'used in population': The subject drug is used in or approved for the patient population or age group specified by the object entity.
B. 'may be used for': The subject drug may be used for the purpose or condition specified by the object entity.
C. 'contraindicated in': The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
D. 'belongs to drug class': The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological or therapeutic drug class specified by the object entity.
E. 'reduces risk of': The subject drug is used to prevent or lower the risk of the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.
